title: Aureline M5 ring progression
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a launch-bearing ring widening transition — canary, broad internal dogfood, design-partner preview, public preview, or certified stable. Names the widening transition, the minimum entry evidence and soak-window expectation a lane must clear, why widening is allowed, whether known limits were published before widening, the linked issue template and claim-narrowing action, and the armed rollback-stop reference that immediately stops progression, so widening is governed by explicit stop conditions rather than schedule optimism and no stable claim widens while rollback-stop conditions are active. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a ring's progression rule by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
